description: Edit a profile you own (needs a key). Send `markdown`, a whole OpenProfile.md that replaces what you wrote before, or any of `name`, `headline`, `emoji`, `pronouns`, `web`, `identity` (key: value, null removes), `sections` (name: body, `none` removes), `handle`, `public`. What you write wins over every source and survives every re-read.

emoji.description: Your mark next to your name: one emoji or an OpenEmoji :shortcode:; empty removes

identity.description: Identity keys: Kind, Emoji, Pronouns, Web, Email, Location, ...; null removes

pronouns.description: As you write them (she/her, they/them, any); empty removes, never inferred

public.description: Listed and pulled by other directories

sections.description: Section bodies by name (accounts, topics, broadcast, guest, ...); the word none removes one

web.description: Your home page (Website, Homepage and Site are the same key); empty removes

name: update_profile
